thermal_refinement_diagnostics.scope: Fixed-source, prescribed-flow thermal refinement diagnostic. Temperatures are retained without clipping. Values outside the published oil range are diagnostic outputs, with physical applicability unresolved.
thermal_refinement_diagnostics.identity: The projected residual change equals the sum of diffusion, transport, stabilization, source-loading and background-loading changes. Component norms do not add and do not separately predict temperature changes.
